purpose: Realistic behavioural prompts for manual or agent-run evaluation. Presence in this file is not evidence that a case was executed.

cases.prompt: Use $pitchdog-design to art-direct a new pitch.dog work page from real case-study assets. It needs to feel unmistakably ours without repeating the homepage.
must: resolve and pin the canonical type-system source
make real work sovereign and close to each claim
use one primary event and at most one secondary whisper per authored scene
author Light, Dark, and System-default states
author phone as an edit
must_not: reuse a fixed homepage sequence or named prototype scene
copy typography values into page-local rules
cases.failure_caught: Website language mistaken for a page template

cases.prompt: Use $pitchdog-design to refine the spacing of this already shipped pitch.dog page. Its typography dependency is pinned to an older approved tag. Do not broaden scope.
must: preserve the existing immutable type-system pin
change only the causal spacing area
report typography migration as out of scope
inspect the affected widths
must_not: upgrade typography because a newer tag exists
cases.failure_caught: Silent dependency migration during a surgical refinement

cases.prompt: Use $pitchdog-design for a new pitch.dog interface. The type-system README, package version, token metadata, and Git tag disagree about the current version.
must: preserve the conflict
name the disagreeing authorities
request an approved immutable source before implementation
must_not: choose main or releases/latest by recency
copy values from an older design artifact and call them current
cases.failure_caught: Plausible typography substituted for verified authority

cases.prompt: Use $pitchdog-design to specify theming for a new pitch.dog web tool. It currently has only a dark mockup.
must: define System, Light, and Dark choices with System as the initial default
author semantic roles separately in Light and Dark
persist explicit overrides and provide reset to System
resolve effective theme before first paint
test a live operating-system change while System is active
must_not: turn theme switching into decorative motion
cases.failure_caught: Theme toggle added without a complete system-default contract

cases.prompt: Use $pitchdog-design to design an icon-heavy pitch.dog asset manager in React. Keep it quick on an ordinary laptop and usable without guessing symbols.
must: use the official Phosphor React adapter
import only used icons
use a coherent weight vocabulary and currentColor
pair ambiguous icons with text
name icon-only controls and preserve adequate targets
verify meaningful icon contrast
must_not: mix icon families or emoji controls
let an icon carry destructive meaning alone
cases.failure_caught: Icon consistency that sacrifices meaning, access, or bundle cost

cases.prompt: Use $pitchdog-design in Mindset Mode for a client whose accepted identity is bright, geometric, sans-led, and uses its own icon library. Build a new responsive product page.
must: preserve the client's accepted type, colour, and icons
author Light, Dark, and System-default values inside that authority
transfer proof, hierarchy, humane states, and artifact verification
derive a subject-native visual thesis
must_not: replace the client's icons with Phosphor
import pitch.dog website choreography or material language

cases.prompt: Use $pitchdog-design to systematise a new client tool. The brand has approved type and colour but no icon direction.
must: preserve the client's type and colour authority
default the missing icon system to Phosphor
record the icon choice as provisional until owner approval
author all three theme choices
must_not: describe a provisional choice as accepted
cases.failure_caught: A useful default promoted into external-brand truth

cases.prompt: Use $pitchdog-design on a pitch.dog page. A moodboard asks for film grain and noisy paper, but the current owner decision says no grain. Keep it tactile.
must: honour the current no-grain owner decision
derive tactility from approved art, boundaries, crop, overlap, contact, marks, and evidence
preserve texture intrinsic to approved source art
run the material-source check
must_not: use noise, SVG turbulence, distressed-paper overlays, or pseudo-texture
substitute fake tape or random rotation

cases.prompt: Use $pitchdog-design to adapt a wide pitch.dog case-study page with sticky proof and marginal notes to a 360px phone.
must: edit priority, proof order, crop, density, and interaction for phone
remove or replace sticky behaviour that no longer serves the argument
preserve credits and proof
check both themes and reduced motion
must_not: stack desktop columns into a long page
shrink type outside the resolved role system
cases.failure_caught: Responsive stacking mistaken for authored translation

cases.prompt: Use $pitchdog-design to art-direct a scroll-linked pitch.dog sequence. The story must still hold with reduced motion and during fast scrolling.
must: make the authored still complete first
give motion a semantic owner and purpose
define interruption, reversal, and fast-scroll terminal state
replace travel with an immediate or short-opacity reduced-motion state
must_not: add motion to meet a quota
cases.failure_caught: Scroll spectacle owns the page instead of the story

cases.prompt: Use $pitchdog-design to make a public pitch.dog portfolio page, but no approved work images or results are available yet.
must: name the missing proof
reduce or withhold unsupported public sections
allow clearly named placeholders only in an internal draft
define the exact approval gate
must_not: invent projects, outcomes, logos, or testimonials
treat an empty visual frame as proof

cases.prompt: Use $pitchdog-design for a pitch.dog case study whose client work has a saturated red identity and strict crop rules.
cases.expected_profile: Brand Mode frame / Client authority proof
must: use pitch.dog authority for the surrounding frame
preserve client colour and crop rules inside proof
keep exact role and credits visible
let the project change the local climate without recolouring it
must_not: tint client work to fit the pitch.dog theme
let the frame compete with proof

cases.prompt: Use $pitchdog-design to turn one experimental pitch.dog chapter into a reusable design-system component. No chapter artifact or second use has been supplied.
must: preserve the missing chapter evidence as unknown
refuse reusable extraction without two representative real uses
request the chapter artifact and a real second use
allow only a local pilot until repeated behaviour is observed
must_not: generalise a one-off scene for catalogue completeness
freeze the homepage into a component kit
use consistency as the only rationale
cases.failure_caught: Component-library art direction flattens the work

cases.prompt: Use $pitchdog-design to review an already strong external-brand checkout flow. Diagnose only; do not edit code. No checkout artifact has been supplied.
must: preserve the missing checkout artifact as an evidence hold
state that functional, system, and taste findings cannot yet be evidenced
request the smallest artifact needed for review
report checks performed and not performed
must_not: invent failures to prove the skill worked

cases.prompt: Use $pitchdog-design to create a printed pitch.dog programme. No digital interface is part of the deliverable.
must: resolve typography through the canonical type system's non-web guidance
use paper, ink, crop, fold, binding, and proofing as real material
verify trim, bleed, colour profile, resolution, and credits
must_not: force a theme toggle or interface icon package into print
cases.failure_caught: Digital system rules pasted into a physical medium
